spans.s: Meghamālin, a companion of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2549 (together with Kāñcana given to Skanda by Meru).
Meghanāda, a warrior of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2564.

Meghapushpa, one of Kṛshṇa's horses. § 552 (Goharaṇap.): IV, 45, 1414 (ºsya javane sadṛśaṃ, sc. the one of Uttara's horses).--§ 562 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 83, 2938 (vājibhiḥ Śaibya-Sugrīva-Mº-Balāhakaiḥ, yoked to the chariot of Kṛshṇa).--§ 596 (Pratijñāp.): VII, 79, 2812.--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 147, 6344 (kāmagaiḥ ŚaibyaSugrīva-MºBalāhakaiḥ…yuktaṃ, sc. the chariot of Kṛshṇa).--§ 617 (Aishīkap.): X, 13, 649 (pārshṇivāhau …Mº-Balāhakau).--§ 639 (Rājadh.): XII, 53, 1917.
Meghasandhi^1, a king. § 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6988 (only B.; C. has by error Meshasandhiḥ, came to the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).

Meghasandhi^2, king [of the Magadhas]
in Rājagṛha, son of Sahadeva. § 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 82, 2438, 2439 (vanquished by Arjuna when he followed the sacrificial horse). Cf. Māgadha, Magadheśvara, Sahadevaja, Sahadevātmaja.
Meghavāhana, a king. § 273 (Rājasūyārambhap.): II, 14, 577 (among the allies of Jarāsandha).
Meghavāsas, an Asura. § 268 (Varuṇasabhāv.): II, 9, 367 (in the palace of Varuṇa).
